propositions: DC adapter lacks convergence test suites for oversized comments and descriptions, unlike Cloud which has two suites that drive values through two passes to detect re-emission of truncated changes.

DC's sanitize_comment method binds both comment and description to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) and reuses the description fitter fit_outbound, creating a coupling risk if the description fitter changes in the future.

The constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) is the correct DC comment ceiling per jira.text.field.character.limit property definition and JRASERVER-28519, but this provenance is not documented at the binding site in the code.

Two-pass convergence must be verified: an oversized comment or description truncated by the first pass must plan no further changes on the second pass, ensuring the truncated value round-trips as equal.

DC's separate convergence test files must be created without modifying Cloud's existing convergence suites, as Cloud tests hardcode Cloud-specific internals (ADF serialization, comment_limits module) not applicable to DC's plain character truncation.
